_comment: Tier-2 for fourc::fpsi#4, and a FALSIFICATION of its Signal. The entry predicted 'stagnating CG/GMRES at very low K'. On upstream fpsi_ofsiinterface.4C.yaml (MAT_FluidPoro PERMEABILITY 1, every field on UMFPACK) a permeability of 1e-15 produces no solver stagnation of any kind (LOW_SOLVER_STAGNATION_MESSAGES=0) but a 4C abort, 'zero porosity!', from fluid_ele/4C_fluid_ele_calc_poro.cpp line 5397 inside FluidEleCalcPoro::compute_stabilization_parameters — the permeability enters the porous stabilisation parameter and the porosity check there fires first. A permeability of 1e+06 runs to the end and returns a different answer with no remark about the Darcy regime (HIGH_DARCY_WARNINGS=0), caught only by the deck's own 2 result tests. Verified by execution 2026-08-06 against 4C at /home/alexander/4C/build/4C (2026.2.0-dev, commit 89519cfe76).
expect_in_output: Result check failed with 2 errors out of 2 tests

_mutation.note: remove the low-permeability pathology: keep the upstream value. LOW_ARM_PERMEABILITY:1 is a forbidden token and the 'zero porosity!' abort vanishes, so the fixture must go red.
remove the high-permeability pathology: keep the upstream value. HIGH_FAILED_TESTS drops to 0 (a forbidden token) and the fixture must go red.
